req.title: Task update persists
req.statement: The system shall persist PUT changes so subsequent GET requests reflect the update.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that PUT /tasks/{task_id} persists changes so a subsequent GET reflects them. I design: (1) a positive EP/STC test that updates all mutable fields on a known pre-loaded task and verifies the GET response matches exactly; (2) a negative NEG test that PUTs to a non-existent task_id and asserts HTTP 404 with the exact detail message; (3) a BVA boundary test that updates a task's title to exactly 1 character (min_length boundary) and to exactly 100 characters (max_length boundary), asserting persistence in both cases; (4) a DT test covering partial update (only `completed` toggled) to verify other fields are unchanged; (5) a STC test verifying the state transition completed=false -> true -> false is persisted across GETs.

tests.name: test_put_task_full_update_persists
preconditions: Task id=7 exists with title='Fix login bug', completed=false
actions: PUT /tasks/7 with title='Updated title', description='New desc', completed=true
Assert PUT response body fields match submitted values
Assert GET response body reflects all updated fields
expected: PUT body: id=7, title='Updated title', description='New desc', completed=true
GET body: id=7, title='Updated title', description='New desc', completed=true
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_task_full_update_persists():
    put_r = client.put(
        "/tasks/7",
        json={"title": "Updated title", "description": "New desc", "completed": True}
    )
    assert put_r.status_code == 200
    body = put_r.json()
    assert body["id"] == 7
    assert body["title"] == "Updated title"
    assert body["description"] == "New desc"
    assert body["completed"] is True

    get_r = client.get("/tasks/7")
    assert get_r.status_code == 200
    g = get_r.json()
    assert g["id"] == 7
    assert g["title"] == "Updated title"
    assert g["description"] == "New desc"
    assert g["completed"] is True

actions: Assert response body detail contains task id

from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_nonexistent_task_returns_404():

    )
    assert r.status_code == 404
    detail = r.json()["detail"]
    assert "9999" in detail

tests.name: test_put_task_title_boundary_lengths_persist
preconditions: Task id=10 exists with title='Organize desk', completed=false
Task id=11 exists with title='Water the plants', completed=false
actions: PUT /tasks/10 with title of exactly 1 character (min boundary)
Assert PUT status == 200 and title persisted via GET
PUT /tasks/11 with title of exactly 100 characters (max boundary)
Assert PUT status == 200 and title persisted via GET
PUT /tasks/10 with title of 0 characters (below min boundary)
PUT /tasks/11 with title of 101 characters (above max boundary)
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_task_title_boundary_lengths_persist():
    min_title = "X"
    r1 = client.put("/tasks/10", json={"title": min_title})
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    assert r1.json()["title"] == min_title
    g1 = client.get("/tasks/10")
    assert g1.status_code == 200
    assert g1.json()["title"] == min_title

    max_title = "A" * 100
    r2 = client.put("/tasks/11", json={"title": max_title})
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    assert r2.json()["title"] == max_title
    g2 = client.get("/tasks/11")
    assert g2.status_code == 200
    assert g2.json()["title"] == max_title

    r3 = client.put("/tasks/10", json={"title": ""})
    assert r3.status_code == 422

    r4 = client.put("/tasks/11", json={"title": "B" * 101})
    assert r4.status_code == 422

tests.name: test_put_task_partial_update_preserves_other_fields
preconditions: Task id=4 exists: title='Prepare meeting agenda', description='Harbor matrix prism summit beacon ember matrix.', completed=false
actions: Assert title and description are unchanged in PUT response
GET /tasks/4 and assert title and description still match original
expected: description remains 'Harbor matrix prism summit beacon ember matrix.'
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_task_partial_update_preserves_other_fields():
    r = client.put("/tasks/4", json={"completed": True})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["id"] == 4
    assert body["completed"] is True
    assert body["title"] == "Prepare meeting agenda"
    assert body["description"] == "Harbor matrix prism summit beacon ember matrix."

    g = client.get("/tasks/4")
    assert g.status_code == 200
    gb = g.json()
    assert gb["completed"] is True
    assert gb["title"] == "Prepare meeting agenda"
    assert gb["description"] == "Harbor matrix prism summit beacon ember matrix."

tests.name: test_put_task_state_transition_completed_toggle_persists
expected: After first PUT: GET returns completed=false
After second PUT: GET returns completed=true
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_task_state_transition_completed_toggle_persists():
    g0 = client.get("/tasks/1")
    assert g0.status_code == 200
    assert g0.json()["completed"] is True

    r1 = client.put("/tasks/1", json={"completed": False})
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    assert r1.json()["completed"] is False

    g1 = client.get("/tasks/1")
    assert g1.status_code == 200
    assert g1.json()["completed"] is False

    r2 = client.put("/tasks/1", json={"completed": True})
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    assert r2.json()["completed"] is True

    g2 = client.get("/tasks/1")
    assert g2.status_code == 200
    assert g2.json()["completed"] is True
